text:
maria: Heads-up — planning a runtime engine push tonight that includes an ABI bump + new quantized matmul kernels. target quiet window 02:00-04:00 UTC. looking for: canary slice plan, pin/ttl proposal, rollback criteria, and a short release-note blurb.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks: build artifacts OK, signatures verified, perf smoke image: queued. Use `deploy-bot set-slice` to start canary.

alex: Noted. matmul kernel v2 -> v3 shows ~10% p99 tail variance on local perf with long-seq workloads. i'll scope a tiny canary (0.5%) and watch p95/p99, kv-cache hit rate, and OOMs.

ryan: +1 small canary. suggest staging warmstart for 10m before traffic shift, then 30m observation. if p99 regresses >15% or error-rate >0.2% => immediate pin rollback.

sre-ops: Quiet window approved 02:00-04:00 UTC for us. prefer pin TTL 6h so ops can inspect logs post-rollback. schedule drain on region-eu first then us-west.

maria: I'll write the rollback criteria down: (1) p99 latency +15% vs baseline for 15m; (2) error-rate delta >0.2% sustained 10m; (3) OOMs on >0.1% of hosts during smoke. If any trigger hit -> pin and shift to fallback model variant.

samira: Release notes draft for docs: "Runtime: ABI bump + curated quant kernels — expect improved throughput for medium sequences; canary staged; automatic fallback to v2 on anomalies." Short and to the point.

alex: Quick FYI: quant build included packing tweak that increases binary by ~8MB. not a blocker but may affect cold start. watch first 5m of warmstart.

deploy-bot: Action: `pin engine:quant-kernel:v3 --ttl=6h --reason="canary+abi-bump"` applied by @maria at 6519999999. Canary command below:
```
# canary: 0.5% -> warmstart 10m -> increase to 1% after green
deploy-bot set-slice --service engine --from v2 --to v3 --slice 0.005 --warmstart 10m
```

ryan: I'll own the telemetry dashboard and alerts (p95/p99, kv cache hit, OOMs). tagging devex for release-note link. :eyes:

sre-ops: We'll run regional drain script between 02:10-02:25 UTC for eu then 02:40-02:55 for us-west. Please avoid any unrelated config changes during window.

maria: thanks all — leaving the release-note stub in `docs/release-notes/engine.md` and posting final canary start when i hit the button. ping me for rollback votes if alarms fire. :thumbsup:
